#include <iostream>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstring>

const int mod = 1e9 + 7;

int add(int a, int b) {
  return a+b >= mod ? a+b-mod : a+b;
}

int mul(int a, int b) {
  return (long long)(a)*b%mod;
}

const int M = 32;

struct matrix {
  int a[M][M];
  matrix() { int i, j; for (i = 0; i < M; i++) for (j = 0; j < M; j++) a[i][j] = 0; }
  
  int* operator [] (int i) { return a[i]; }
  friend matrix operator * (matrix a, matrix b) {
    matrix r;
    int i, j, k;
    for (i = 0; i < M; i++) for (j = 0; j < M; j++) for (k = 0; k < M; k++) 
      r[i][j] = add(r[i][j], mul(a[i][k], b[k][j]));
    return r;
  }
};

const int MAXD = 64;
const int MAXK = 32;

matrix f[MAXD];
int k;

matrix calc_matrix(int n, int off) {
  matrix ans;
  int i, j;
  for (i = k + (i == k ? 0 : 1); i <= k; i++) for (j = k + (j == k ? 0 : 1); j <= k; j++) {
    int ni = i == k ? i : (i + off)%k;
    int nj = j == k ? j : (j + off)%k;
    ans[ni][nj] = f[n][i-k][j-k];
  }
  return ans;
}

int sum_digits(long long n) {
  int ans = 0;
  while (n > 0) {
    ans += n%k;
    n /= k;
  }
  return ans%k;
}

int main(void) {
  long long n;
  int k;
  std::cin >> n >> k;

  int ndigits = 0;
  long long tmp = n;
  while (tmp > 0) {
    tmp /= k;
    ndigits++;
  }

  matrix id;
  for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) id[i][i] = 1;

  f[0] = id;
  for (int i = k + 1, j = 0; i >= 0; i--) f[0][i][0] = 1;
  for (int i = 1; i <= ndigits; i++) {
    f[i] = id;
    for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) f[i] = f[i] * calc_matrix(i - 1, j);
  }

  long long cur = 0;
  long long pw = 1;

  ndigits--;
  for (; ndigits >= 0; ndigits--) pw *= k;

  matrix ans = id;
  while (cur < n) {
    assert(ndigits >= 0);
    while (cur + pw <= n) {
      ans = ans * calc_matrix(ndigits, sum_digits(cur));
      cur += pw;
    }
    pw /= k;
  }

  int sum = 0;
  for (int i = k + 1; i >= 0; i--) sum = add(sum, ans[k][i]);
  std::cout << sum << std::endl;
  return 0;
}
